FIFA Chief Defends Hydration Breaks Amid Criticism

FIFA President Gianni Infantino has defended the inclusion of hydration breaks during the World Cup, stating it is a purely sporting matter. He also addressed criticism by asserting that these breaks do not generate any additional revenue for FIFA. The comments come amidst some backlash regarding the breaks.
